[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on completing your duathlon! That's a great achievement!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Improving endurance requires a well-structured training plan that incorporates cardiovascular exercises, strength training, and high-intensity interval training (HIIT).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Cardiovascular exercises recommended include running, cycling, and optional swimming.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For running, continue to build endurance with regular runs, focusing on increasing weekly mileage by 10-15% each week.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Incorporate tempo runs, hill repeats, and longer runs (3-5 miles) to improve running efficiency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For cycling, increase endurance with longer bike rides (15-30 miles) at a moderate pace and incorporate interval training.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Swimming can be an excellent cross-training activity to improve cardiovascular endurance, focusing on longer swims (20-30 minutes) at a moderate pace.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Strength training recommendations include lower body exercises (squats, lunges, deadlifts, leg press, calf raises, step-ups), core exercises (planks, Russian twists, leg raises, bicycle crunches), and upper body exercises (push-ups, dumbbell rows, shoulder press, bicep curls, tricep dips).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] HIIT workouts recommended include running intervals (4-6 x 400m at a fast pace, with 200m active recovery) and cycling intervals (4-6 x 1-mile sprints at high intensity, with 1-mile active recovery).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include incorporating brick workouts, strength training twice a week, rest days, monitoring progress, and gradually increasing training volume and intensity.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Stay hydrated, fuel with a balanced diet, and get adequate sleep (7-9 hours) to support training.
